Flow 3.7.0

Flow 3.7.0 fixes GET-only signed download URLs that reject HEAD requests, including APKMirror. It also adds dynamic redistribution of unfinished byte ranges, configurable connection and queue concurrency, download properties with safe filename editing and notes, and text-file link import/export. The default remains eight connections and automatic reductions are disabled.

Chrome extension 2.2.0 adds optional file-type capture filters and site exclusions without additional permissions.

Developer preview: Apple signing and notarization pending.

Flow 3.6.4

Flow 3.6.4 preserves the filename provided by Chrome, including spaces and file extensions. Browser capture connection repairs and popup status are included.

Developer preview: Apple signing and notarization pending.

Flow 3.6.3

Flow 3.6.3 — Keep Chrome capture connected

Flow repairs its existing Chrome native bridge registration on launch, pointing to the current app even after an old copy or alias is removed. Registration resolves symlinks to avoid stale alias paths.

The extension checks the bridge when its popup opens and reports connection and capture status. Successful automatic captures clear old error badges. Browser downloads remain available if the handoff fails.

Developer preview: Apple signing and notarization remain pending.
